At this driving school, the instructors exploit the situation by requesting additional funds under the pretenses of "Gurudakshina" and "Chai Pani." The explanation provided is the protracted RTO processes, but this reasoning lacks justification. This delay can pose a challenge, especially if you lack a personal vehicle for additional practice.
